notes: FlexRay characterization centers on bit timing (10 Mbit/s differential NRZ, 8x oversampling), the synchronized macrotick / clock synchronization, the TDMA/FTDMA slot timing, and wakeup/coldstart. Conformance is established by the FlexRay conformance test (ISO 17458-5). Per-node oscillator and PHY calibration is done at bring-up.

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: Bit timing / eye at 10 Mbit/s
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: Verify the 100 ns bit time and differential NRZ eye on BP/BM; confirm 8x oversampling and 5-sample majority voting recover bits correctly.

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: Macrotick / clock-sync accuracy
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: Confirm the macrotick has the same duration cluster-wide and that offset/rate correction keeps nodes synchronized within tolerance.

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: Static-slot timing
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: Verify each static slot's macrotick boundaries and that the slot owner transmits exactly in its window.

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: Dynamic-segment minislotting
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: Confirm minislot counter hold/advance behavior and priority ordering.

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: Wakeup / coldstart
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: Validate WUP/WUS detection and CAS + startup-frame coldstart with >=2 coldstart nodes.

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: CRC coverage
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: Inject errors and confirm the 11-bit Header CRC and 24-bit Frame CRC detect them.

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: Active-star timing
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: Measure propagation through active star couplers within the configured timing limits.
